effectiveFrom.description: When this preset is meant to take effect. Recorded for audit; activation is still an explicit step.

settings.description: The tuning numbers this preset supplies. Partial is allowed — anything absent falls through to the built-in defaults.

count.description: Number of items actually returned on this page.

endCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page (null when empty).

hasNextPage.description: True when another page exists after this one (fetch with `endCursor`).

hasPreviousPage.description: True when this page was requested with a cursor.

limit.description: The page size that was requested.

startCursor.description: Cursor of the first item on this page (null when empty).

milkUreaNitrogen.description: mg/dL. Milk Urea Nitrogen, a feed-protein-balance indicator.

sampleDate.description: Day the sample was taken (UTC midnight).

somaticCellCount.description: Cells per mL. Elevated SCC is the primary mastitis/udder-health signal.

availableL.description: Litres available to sell right now.

changes.description: Sparse map of requirement settings to change, e.g. { "proteinPerLitreMilk": 90 }. Absent fields inherit.

notes.description: Why this farm deviates from the standard model.
